laborWage.note: Labor = labor-hours × crew rate. Div 01 GC supervision salaried; subcontractor lump sums keep quoted value.

caveats: 85% of direct cost is dimensioned (measured or calc-from-drawing-dims); remainder is scope not shown on the drawings.
Every line carries its dimensional basis (dim field) and sheet reference.
Drawings stamped NOT FOR PERMITTING — used for estimation only.
Elevator + commercial-kitchen equipment excluded (confirmed present on A001/E101).
